description.value: TG-07-04 (PS-ENT-04): de AllergyIntolerance van de eerste entry van sectie Allergieën en intoleranties conformeert aan http://hl7.eu/fhir/base/StructureDefinition/allergyIntolerance-eu-core (wordt M op T2).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-07-13 (PS-TRM-02): elk AllergyIntolerance.code in sectie Allergieën en intoleranties heeft minimaal één coding met system en code.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(code.coding.where(system.exists() and code.exists()).exists())

description.value: TG-07-14 (PS-TRM-03): elk AllergyIntolerance.code in sectie Allergieën en intoleranties heeft een SNOMED CT-coding.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct').exists())

description.value: TG-07-15 (PS-TRM-04): elke coding van AllergyIntolerance.code in sectie Allergieën en intoleranties heeft een display.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(code.coding.all(display.exists()))
